requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeting SMB customers with 5-250 employees, aiming for high ROI and efficiency. Includes support for AMPV of ~500 pages and usability for non-IT trained office managers/generalists.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for the CISS PLE segment, enabling HP to compete in a $9.5B segment and retain SMB market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is released with ink tank technology, meets SMB usability standards, and supports AMPV requirements.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven features for print, scan, and workflow management. Includes 'Perfect Print', 'Perfect Scan', and AI solutions for device support and consolidation.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan from competitors by providing superior productivity and manageability solutions for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are implemented and validated through user testing, demonstrating improved productivity and manageability.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for device management tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs, enabling easy setup, monitoring, and maintenance by office managers/generalists.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB pain points around manageability and lack of IT resources; differentiates Magellan as a user-friendly solution.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is functional, supports multi-device management, and passes usability tests with target SMB users.

requirements.Title: Low Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan delivers HP's lowest business TCO, minimizing intervention and maximizing sustainability with 60% RCP (recycled content plastic).
requirements.Rationale: Key competitive advantage for SMBs seeking cost efficiency and sustainability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is validated through cost analysis and sustainability metrics compared to competitors.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80k pages or 2 years (whichever is first). Enable customer replaceable parts (PHA) and service center support (MINK) post-warranty. Target customer replaceable threshold.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and ease of maintenance for SMBs lacking IT resources.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are documented and parts are customer replaceable within defined thresholds.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refill
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure ease of use for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors and supports hassle-free maintenance for non-IT trained users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are tested and validated for error-proof operation.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Compatibility
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must support improved speed (25/20 min), PDL/PS compatibility, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB requirements for performance and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU passes performance tests, supports PDL/PS, and achieves Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKU must support SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS (Printing-as-a-Service).
requirements.Rationale: Enables differentiated offerings for SMBs with varying needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU features are implemented and validated with SMB user groups.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Integrate a replaceable maintenance box for easier servicing and reduced downtime, targeting customer replaceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance burden for SMBs and supports longer device lifespan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily replaceable by end-users and validated through usability testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printer uses 60% RCP in its construction, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Provides a strong sustainability value proposition to SMBs and differentiates HP from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer construction uses 60% RCP, validated by supply chain and sustainability audits.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing capabilities via HP App for SMB customers, enabling easy printing from mobile devices.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses modern SMB workflows and enhances usability for non-IT users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is functional and validated through integration and user testing.

requirements.Title: Printing-as-a-Service (PaaS) Support
requirements.Description: Enable PaaS offerings for Magellan, allowing SMBs to access managed print services and solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage; meets evolving SMB needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are integrated and validated with SMB customers.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for device health, usage, and support analytics, tailored for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support and device management for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features are implemented and validated through internal and customer testing.

requirements.Title: Advanced Security and Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan meets SMB security and regulatory requirements, including Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports SMBs in regulated industries and meets competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes security and compliance audits, achieves Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Solutions Monetization
requirements.Description: Develop features and business models enabling monetization of Magellan's AI solutions and SMB portal over the next 3-5 years.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's strategic goal for solutions enhancement and monetization in the SMB segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Monetization features are implemented and validated through pilot programs and market feedback.
